{{Quote|Oh, thank you so much! Once I've made it back to my family, I'll make it a point to send you one of my famous garrenberry pies! Now let's go!|Deasie A'Fresel|<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Deasie A'Fresel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[entertainer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was the sister of [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Tennelt]], and the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Taergle]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateEntertainer.png|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Deasie A'Fresel]]
Deasie A'Fresel was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].

Although not mentioned in the quest dialogue, examining her revealed her to be an entertainer. However, it should be noted that this was primarily due to game mechanics, as a result of A'Fresel being placed under the randomized entertainer spawn template appearance.
